question.text: The maximum and minimum amplitude of an amplitude modulated wave is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>16</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> respectively. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is _______. (Round off your answer to the nearest integer)
